contentBlocks.text: ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਭੂਗੋਲ ਬਾਰੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਕੁਝ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ! (This week you learned so much about Punjab's geography!) Let's review it all.

Quick review: ਦਰਿਆ (rivers) — ਸਤਲੁਜ, ਬਿਆਸ, ਰਾਵੀ (Day 1). ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ (farming) words — ਖੇਤ, ਕਣਕ, ਜ਼ਮੀਨ (Day 2). ਸ਼ਹਿਰ (city) — ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ (Day 3). Persuasive words — ਸੋਹਣਾ, ਦੇਖਣਾ, ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ (Day 4). Read your own persuasive piece from yesterday out loud one more time, then match each vocabulary word below to its meaning.
ਸ਼ਾਬਾਸ਼! (Well done!) You now know real Punjabi vocabulary for Punjab's rivers, farmland, and cities — and you've used it in real persuasive writing of your own.

objectives: Recall all new vocabulary words learned this week across rivers, farmland, city, and persuasive language
Correctly match each vocabulary word to its meaning
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through vocabulary review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child read their own persuasive piece from Day 4 aloud.
3. Complete the cumulative review worksheet.
4. Discuss any mismatches or uncertain answers together before finishing.
5. Celebrate finishing a real week of geography vocabulary AND persuasive writing in Punjabi.
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow the child to use their Day 1-4 worksheets as a reference during review rather than working from memory alone
Ready for more: ask them to add one more sentence to their persuasive piece using a word they haven't used yet
This is a genuine milestone — real geography vocabulary combined with real persuasive composition in the same week
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. ਦਰਿਆ = river. 2. ਖੇਤ = field. 3. ਸ਼ਹਿਰ = city. 4. ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ = important.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates the week's geography vocabulary and persuasive-writing skills, matching the course's own 'geography of Punjab' and 'persuasive writing' descriptions together in one final review.

worksheet.title: The Geography of Punjab: Week 1 Review

generationData.instructions: Write the English meaning of each word.
